subject: Data-address-identifier
notes: kb/Work PB1042 (wave 1021 B2). GR1 'Data-address-identifier creates a unique data item of class pointer and category data-pointer that contains the address of identifier-1'. The one PARTIAL residue (ADDRESS OF a group CONTAINING a dynamic-capacity table refused COBOL0869, though §8.4.3.11.3 SR6 bars only an element of / an item subordinate to such a table) is closed: the ADDRESS-OF cell forcer (ForceStringCanonical, the one forcer of the three cell surfaces) now carries the table as a cell component. Measured: SET P TO ADDRESS OF DT with DT holding OCCURS DYNAMIC ... INITIALIZED, then SET ADDRESS OF B TO P; DT grows by receiving subscript and SET UP BY, its INITIALIZED occurrences take their VALUEs, LENGTH(DT) and INITIALIZE DT are correct, and the BASED view B reads DT's fixed run. Editions: ADDRESS OF from 2002.
